svg.title: Contour — music video style reference (c2-contour)
svg.desc: A topographic survey sheet. Every noun the song sings becomes a landform in contour lines, and the lyric is the quadrangle's name along the foot. Frame is 1600x900; the strip below the frame is apparatus, not part of the film.
svg.text: SECTION VARIATION — THE SAME STYLE AT FIVE POINTS IN THE SONG
The quad is named in the collar; the contours
ink themselves in, one per beat.
A new sheet per line, its contours going down
word by word from the sea up.
The massif. One red dashed trail runs up the
valley at the pace of the line.
No lyric. The sheet pans a long ridge and the
collar prints its section, A to A′.
landforms, lettered as each is sung.
